objective: JS/TS family targets (.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs/.ts/.tsx) must never come back as source_graph_required_empty_result -- add truthful file-level authority (path/hash/language/size/status) for this family, without fabricating functions/calls/edges, and without regressing Python AST semantics.

root_cause.description: iter_source_files() in source_graph.py only globbed *.py, and source_graph_ast.extract_file() returned status=unsupported_fail_closed with zero entities for every non-Python file. A JS/TS target therefore always produced an empty entities/FTS match set, which project_context.collect_project_context() turns into ProjectContextError('source_graph_required_empty_result') whenever task_type=code and source_graph.required=true.
root_cause.fix: source_graph_ast.py: added JS_TS_LANGUAGE_BY_EXTENSION (.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs -> javascript, .ts/.tsx -> typescript) and _extract_file_evidence(), which records exactly one kind='file' entity per JS/TS file (name/qualname=relative path, signature='bytes=<exact size>', evidence_label=FILE_EVIDENCE, status='file_evidence_only') and zero edges -- no parser, no invented functions/classes/calls/imports. source_graph.py: iter_source_files() now globs the JS/TS family alongside *.py (new INDEXED_EXTENSIONS constant), and DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_DIR_NAMES gained 'CMakeFiles' so CMake-generated *.ts dependency-timestamp files (not real TypeScript) are never mislabeled as typescript evidence.

before.behavior: sg.iter_source_files() never yielded .js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs/.ts/.tsx paths; sgast.extract_file() on any such file returned status='unsupported_fail_closed', entities=(), edges=(). sg.find/focus/slice/bundle on a JS/TS target returned an empty matches list; project_context with task_type=code and source_graph.required=true raised source_graph_required_empty_result for that target.
before.note: Snapshot taken from the pre-existing canonical /home/shrek/GeoAI/.aiworkhub/source_graph/source_graph.sqlite before this task's incremental rebuild.

after.behavior: sg.iter_source_files() also globs the JS/TS family (INDEXED_EXTENSIONS = ('.py',) + JS_TS_EXTENSIONS). sgast.extract_file() on a JS/TS file returns status='file_evidence_only' with exactly one kind='file' entity carrying real language/path/hash/byte-size, edges=(). find/focus/slice/bundle on a JS/TS target now return a non-empty, budget-bounded match set built entirely from that one file-evidence entity -- no fabricated semantic content.
